title: Light Fluffy Russian Beef Wrap
description: A comforting Russian dish featuring tender beef and fluffy wraps, flavored with garam masala and wrapped in a low-fat friendly ssam-wrap.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together garam masala, salt, and black pepper to create a spice blend.
Add the sliced beef to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice blend.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the beef until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Warm the ssam-wrap pieces by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spreading a layer of low-fat sour cream on each piece, followed by a few slices of the beef mixture and some chopped dill.
Serve the wraps immediately and enjoy.
Garnish with additional chopped dill if desired.
